description: Every market on Lighter on Robinhood Chain (stock, ETF, commodity and crypto perps, and stock spot pairs against USDG): mark price, 24h move and volume, open interest, the latest funding (paid hourly; positive means longs pay shorts) and the same rate held for a year, max leverage and the smallest order. Filter by kind, sort by volume, funding (largest either way), open interest or the 24h move. Read only; cached a minute.
name: get_lighter_markets
title: Lighter RH perps and spot markets
